thread:
samuel (support): Customer ticket #R-2198 — getting 413 from /v1/rerank when ranking ~180 short docs. Customer says their UI shows only ~4KB of text, but our logs show a 413. Can someone help triage?
samuel (support): Payload snippet customer pasted: `{'query': '...long search string...', 'passages': [{'id': 'p1', 'text': '...'}, ...]}`. They included no embeddings, just plain text.
support-bot: New ticket created: R-2198. Linked to customer ACME-Cloud. SLA: standard.
priya (eng-ml): Quick sanity check — rerank enforces token-based input ceiling (query + all docs) not raw bytes. If they pasted long HTML or base64 it would blow tokens. Do we have the exact request size in tokens?
leo (eng-runtime): Logs show: `status=413 code=INPUT_TOO_LARGE detail="token ceiling exceeded: 126,432 tokens (limit 65,536)"` — so it's hitting token limit, not char limit. Looks like doc expansion because of emojis / unescaped markup?
samuel (support): Customer insists each doc is <1KB and only 180 docs; they think limits are by doc count. They asked why error message says 413 with ambiguous text. Wants repro steps to show them.
priya (eng-ml): Can you ask for the exact JSON they sent (full body) or a redacted version that preserves lengths? We'll repro locally. Also need the model and rerank params (truncate=true/false?).
maria (acct-mgr): FYI customer is on metered hosted plan and worried about billing surprises if we ask them to resubmit many times. Can support provide safe repro without charging them repeatedly?
leo (eng-runtime): Repro recipe: 1) send their JSON to our dev endpoint with header `X-RW-DEV-TYPE: repro` which bypasses billing meter and marks request non-billable; 2) run token count util `rw-tokenizer count --model rerank-v1 --input payload.json` to get exact token count; 3) if > limit, show them breakdown per field with `rw-tokenizer --breakdown`.
samuel (support): Passing reagent: sent customer repro instructions and dev endpoint. They replied with a redacted payload (kept doc lengths). Pasting their `rw-tokenizer --breakdown` output: `query: 1,234 tokens, passages[0..179]: avg 710 tokens each -> total ~128,234 tokens`.
priya (eng-ml): That aligns. Long story: some docs include concatenated scraped transcripts with repeated context; average 710 tokens is heavy. We'll propose two mitigations: 1) server-side fallback to snippet mode that cuts passages to X tokens and returns partial scores; 2) improve 413 message to include token totals and which field triggered the exceed (e.g., "query+passages: 128,234 tokens, limit 65,536").
maria (acct-mgr): Customer approves fallback snippet approach for now if it avoids re-ingesting and limits bill shock. They asked for an ETA on message change so they can update internal UX.
leo (eng-runtime): Short-term: we can push a message text change in hosted API (config) within 2 days: text includes token counts and a KB link. Longer-term: implement server-side snippet fallback for rerank; needs spec and safety checks, estimate 3–4 sprints.
samuel (support): I drafted a KB note for the customer with repro steps, the token breakdown suggestion, and a cURL example using dev header: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACT" \
  -H "X-RW-DEV-TYPE: repro" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d @redacted_payload.json
```
samuel (support): Also suggested immediate UX update: change 413 body to include "\"token_summary\": {\"total\": n, \"limit\": m, \"fields\": {\"query\": x, \"passages\": y}}" so integrators can programmatically adapt.
priya (eng-ml): +1 on structured token_summary. We'll review safe info exposure (don't echo raw text).
maria (acct-mgr): I'll notify customer timeline and offer to open a dedicated Private session for assisted trimming if they want.
samuel (support): Marking thread resolved for now — customer accepted dev repro route and KB. Re-open if they hit anything else.
